jobs.title: Marketing Lead
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

AIM builds autonomy for the real world: robots that move mountains. Our systems bring together software, hardware, and robotics to turn heavy equipment into intelligent machines that reshape how earthmoving is done.

We're looking for a Marketing Lead to tell that story to the enterprise buyers who run mines, construction sites, and other heavy-industry operations. You will create the product-marketing materials and programs our sales, business development, field operations, product, and executive teams use to influence, win, and grow customers, and you will regularly measure whether they work.




ABOUT YOU

You understand technology deeply and get genuinely excited about it. You can learn how software, hardware, and robotics systems work, then explain their features and value in a way that holds up with our engineers and lands with customers.

You move fast. When someone asks for an idea, you draft it and share it quickly, then refine it with feedback.

You think in numbers. You frame marketing results objectively, in terms of engagement, meetings, conversion, and revenue impact, and you use that data to decide what to do next.

You are a dependable partner to sales. You have worked alongside enterprise or B2B sales teams, delivered what they needed consistently, and improved their results.

You set ambitious goals and hit them. Together with business development and executive partners, you commit to aggressive targets for customer awareness, conversion, and account expansion.

You are persuasive. Your passion for products and technology is evident and contagious, and you can make a convincing case to customers and colleagues alike.




WHAT YOU WILL OWN

Product marketing that influences buying decisions

 - Create and maintain materials that help enterprise buyers make purchase decisions, including product overviews, ROI calculators, use-case documentation, customer-facing roadmaps and vision statements, and onboarding and deployment guides.

 - Work with product management and engineering to turn technical capabilities into clear, accurate, customer-focused messaging.

 - Equip sales, business development, field operations, and executives with the materials they need to support their counterparts during each stage of the customer journey.

Category leadership and awareness

 - Establish AIM as a leader in autonomy for heavy equipment, and measurably strengthen that position over time.

 - Produce engaging content for LinkedIn, X, industry sites, and the AIM website, including video and product stories.

 - Earn unpaid media coverage in industry and national outlets.

Customer communication

 - Own customer contact lists and regular customer updates.

 - Help existing customers understand new capabilities and expand their use of AIM.

Plans, targets, and measurement

 - Write and execute marketing plans with specific deliverables, dates, and targets for engagement, meetings, and sales conversion.

 - Track results, report them clearly, and adjust based on what the numbers show.
   
   


YOUR FIRST 90 DAYS

In your first three months, you will:

 1. Build or update a core product-marketing toolkit: ROI calculators, use-case documents, application briefs, customer-facing roadmaps, and onboarding and deployment guides.

 2. Organize our customer contacts and begin regular product updates to AIM's customers.

 3. Refresh the AIM website with compelling video footage and product information.

 4. Secure five unpaid media placements in industry or national outlets.
    
    


QUALIFICATIONS

 - 5+ years of marketing experience in B2B technology, such as SaaS, robotics, automation, or technology services.

 - A track record of creating product-marketing materials for enterprise buyers, such as TCO/payback/ROI calculators and use-case documentation, that demonstrably influenced purchasing decisions.

 - A portfolio of work, with links, showing content that earned strong engagement (clicks, shares, reactions) on LinkedIn, X, or industry websites.

 - Experience writing and executing marketing plans tied to specific deliverables, dates, and measurable targets such as engagement, qualified leads, meetings, or sales conversion.

 - A key role in establishing a product or company as a leader in its B2B technology category, with evidence that its position improved over time.

 - Experience working closely with enterprise or B2B sales teams and improving their results.

 - The ability to learn technical products and communicate them accurately enough to earn the confidence of product and engineering teams.

 - Comfort measuring and reporting marketing results with numbers, percentages, and clear analysis.
   
   


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Startup or early-stage company experience.

 - Experience marketing to mining, construction, waste management, or other heavy-industry customers.

 - Background in product marketing, product management, or field operations for hardware, robotics, or industrial technology.

 - 

Base Compensation Range - $160,000 - $210,000

jobs.title: HRBP
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

AIM builds autonomy for the real world: robots that move mountains. Our systems bring together software, hardware, and robotics to turn heavy equipment into intelligent machines that reshape how earthmoving is done.

We're looking for a Human Resources Business Partner to build the people foundation that helps our team work together and conquer ambitious challenges. You will turn business goals into people objectives, create HR processes from the ground up, and own the employee experience from the first day through every stage of growth. You'll partner closely with executives and managers, and you'll measure progress with sensible KPIs and clear, trusted data.




ABOUT YOU

You bring out the best in people. You don’t have an antiquated view of HR as just a risk-mitigation function – you see human and organizational potential, and you build the programs, coaching, and paths that turn them into personal, professional, and company growth.

You have both a warm bedside manner and a strong backbone. You handle sensitive conversations with care, and you hold firm when the situation calls for it.

You push back respectfully. You make well-evidenced arguments to executives and managers, and you stay flexible as you learn more.

You are approachable and easy to understand. Employees and leaders trust you, come to you early, and leave conversations knowing what happens next. People trust your decisions because they are made calmly and objectively.

You think about the whole employee lifecycle, from offer and onboarding through development, retention, and departure, and you connect each stage into one coherent experience.

You are skilled at and comfortable with guiding people and organizations through change, whether exciting or simply necessary, to help them achieve their full potential.

You turn legal and compliance requirements into a fair, healthy culture, so that doing the right thing is also the natural way people work here.




WHAT YOU WILL OWN

Talent development and growth

 - Author, communicate, and drive adoption of talent development frameworks covering performance reviews, career and job growth, succession planning, and retention

 - Train managers on performance management and give them the tools to develop their teams

 - Build plans to retain top talent and a clear, consistent approach to attrition

HR foundations

 - Build practical HR processes from scratch where none exist, and improve them as the company grows

 - Create role-leveling and compensation frameworks grounded in market benchmarks

 - Own our HRIS and the data in it so that employee information is accurate, trusted, and the source of truth for decisions,

 - Use technology wisely to automate repetitive and formulaic tasks both to improve the employee experience and to maximize your leverage on your time

Employee relations and compliance

 - Handle complex and high-priority cases, including both opportunities and risks related to performance, retention, and team dynamics

 - Write and maintain growth-oriented HR policies that comply with employment law, and ensure that risk is well managed and communicated

 - Communicate new and existing policies clearly, in writing and in person, through all-company channels

Partnership and measurement

 - Work with executives to turn business goals into people objectives

 - Bridge talent acquisition and talent development so that hiring, onboarding, and growth form one connected experience

 - Define what HR success looks like in measurable terms, track it, and report progress
   
   


YOUR FIRST 90 DAYS

In your first three months, you will:

 1. Create a role-leveling and compensation benchmarking framework and policy, and share it with the company

 2. Select and deploy a new HRIS, including migrating all key information from our current system

 3. Develop and roll out a talent development framework, with plans for retaining top talent, manager training on performance management, and our approach to attrition

 4. Take ownership of high-priority HR cases involving growth, retention, and performance management

 5. Communicate new HR policies, and reinforce existing ones, in writing and in person across the company
    
    


QUALIFICATIONS

 - 5+ years of experience in HR or People roles

 - Startup experience building HR processes from scratch, including working with executives to turn business goals into people objectives

 - Experience bridging talent acquisition and talent development, and building a growth-oriented employee lifecycle across performance reviews, career growth, succession planning, retention, and manager training

 - The ability to define and measure HR success with numbers and clear metrics

 - A leadership role in People, Talent, or HR where you made well-evidenced arguments and adapted as circumstances changed

 - A track record of using software tools and systems to automate repetitive or formulaic work

 - Experience developing HR policy, with working knowledge of employment law and compliance, and experience handling complex risk such as performance problems and labor-law matters
   
   


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience selecting, implementing, or migrating an HRIS

 - Experience building role-leveling frameworks and compensation benchmarking

 - SHRM-CP/SCP or PHR certifications



Base Compensation Range - $140,000 - $190,000
